 Apple Accounts Experiencing Issues
 Tuesday November 17, 2026 9:47 am PST by Juli Clover Apple Accounts and iCloud sign-ins appear to be experiencing issues, according to multiple social media reports and Apple's System Status page . 
Apple says ‌iCloud‌ Account and Sign In may be slow or experiencing issues, but there are no other outages listed on the site. 
 There are also reports on social media about Apple retail stores and other services like Apple Music and Apple Pay experiencing issues. Anything related to an Apple Account seems to be malfunctioning, with users unable to sign in.
